editorial:
If you love dark comedy where everything goes wrong, this one is for you. The story kicks off when a disc containing a former CIA analyst's memoirs ends up with two gym workers, Linda and Chad. They see a quick payday that could fund Linda's life-changing cosmetic surgery, but their simple plan spirals into total chaos. The vibe is sharp, cynical, and packed with awkward moments that make you laugh and cringe at the same time. Every character thinks they are smarter than they really are, which makes the mess even funnier to watch.

The acting is top-notch, with a star-studded cast playing clueless and desperate characters perfectly. The pacing is brisk, and the humor lands hard, though some jokes may feel too dark for everyone. If you enjoy smart, offbeat comedies, you will have a great time. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the chaos peaks when several characters are killed or arrested, and the CIA bosses try to make sense of the mess. Linda gets her surgery money through a deal, while Chad is killed. The twist is that none of it mattered—the memoirs were worthless, and the whole disaster was pointless. The movie ends with the CIA deciding to just forget everything happened.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedies and sharp satire.
